base_info: TFT Set 14: Cyber City Update TFT 14. New Set 14 Synergies. AD means attack damage. AP meants ability power. MR means magic resist. When asked about Shields of Durability, make sure to understand that they are different terms and are not interchangable.

Anima Squad.effect: At each tier, pick a weapon that a random Anima Squad champion fires periodically during combat. Anima Squad champions gain Armor, Magic Resist, and Damage Amp.(3) - 10 armor and magic resist, 5% damage amp,Choose a weapon,(5) - 20 armor and magic resist, 10% damage amp,Choose a weapon, (7) - 30 armor and magic resist, 15% damage amp, Choose a weapon, (10) - 50 armor and magic resist, 25% damage amp,Choose an ultimate weapon.

Boombots.effect: BoomBots fire a missile every 400 damage dealt at a nearby enemy that deals magic damage. 8% of damage taken contributes to damage dealt.(2) - 145 magic damage, (4) - 310 magic damage, (6) - Fire two missiles, each dealing 190 magic damage.

Cyberboss.effect: Your strongest Cyberboss upgrades to its final form and gains Health, Ability Power, and its ability hits more enemies. (2) - 18% health, 15 ability power, (3) - 25% health, 25 ability power, (4) - All Cyberbosses upgrade, Your strongest Cyberboss gains 33% health and 30 ability power.

Cypher.effect: Gain Intel by losing combat, increased for loss streaks. Gain a small amount for killing enemies. You may trade your Intel for loot one time on round 3-3, 3-7, 4-3, 4-7, or 5-5. After trading Intel, Cypher champions gain Attack Damage and Ability Power. (3) - 1x Intel, 25% attack damage and ability power, (4) - 1.5x Intel, 35% attack damage and ability power, (5) - 2x Intel, 45% attack damage and ability power.

Divinicorp.effect: Divinicorp champions grant unique stats to your team, increased for each Divinicorp in play. Divinicorp champions gain double. (1) - 100% bonus, (2) - 110% bonus, (3) - 125% bonus, (4) - 145% bonus, (5) - 165% bonus, (6) - 185% bonus, (7) - 200% bonus.

Exotech.effect: Gain unique items that can only be equipped by Exotech champions. They gain Health and Attack Speed for each item equipped. (3) - 30 health, 2% attack speed , gain Exotech Item, (5) - 110 health, 3% attack speed , gain Exotech Item, (7) - 200 health, 7% attack speed, gain Exotech Item, (10) - 500 health, 40% attack speed, Enhance.

God of the Net.effect: After 2 player combats, open an Armory of Trait Mods that permanently reprogram a champion to benefit from a trait (but not contribute). Every time you get a Trait Mod, the next one requires 1 additional round.

Golden Ox.effect: Golden Ox gain Damage Amp and have a chance to drop gold on kill. If you spend 8 gold on rerolls or XP in a single turn, permanently increase their Damage Amp and the gold required for the next bonus. Rerolls count double towards gold spent.(Golden Ox must have fought last round). (2) - 18% damage amp, 20% gold, (4) - 20% damage amp, 30% gold, (6) - 22% damage amp, 66% loot, 8% chance loot is a component.

Nitro.effect: Every round, Nitro champions grant Chrome to R-080T, based on their star level. Each Chrome grants 14 Health and 1 Ability Power. At 200 Chrome, it upgrades to T-43X!, (3) - Summon R-080T!, (4) - Fire a giant laser!

Overlord.effect: The Overlord takes a bite out of the unit in the hex behind him, dealing 40% of their max Health as true damage. He gains 40% of their Health and 33% of their Attack Damage.

Soul Killer.effect: Gain a hologram copy of the highest cost enemy Viego helped kill last round. It has 600/900/3000 Health, deals 30%/40%/200% damage, and has 1 recommended item.

Street Demon.effect: Allies in painted hexes gain Health, Ability Power, and Attack Damage. Some hexes are Signature hexes and grant 50% more. Street Demons double all bonuses. (3) - 6% health, 6 ability power, 6% attack damage, (5) - 10% health, 10 ability power, 10% attack damage, (7) - 15% health, 15 ability power, 15% attack damage, (10) - 40% health, 40 abilty power, 40% attack damage, and paint the town!

Syndicate.effect: Get a Kingpin hat that uniquely upgrades a Syndicate champion's ability. Syndicate champions gain Health and Damage Amp. (3) - 100 health, 5% damage amp, 1 Kingpin, (5) - 450 health, 20% damage amp, 2 Kingpins, (7) - 600 health, 30% damage amp, Upgrade Kingpin effect.

Virus.effect: The Virus infects your shop with a 10% chance to spawn a bloblet. When purchased, it merges and increases the strongest Zac's max Health by 3% and Ability Power by 5.

A.M.P..effect: A.M.P. champions upgrade their abilities in unique ways with Amp. They also gain Health. (2) - 1 A.M.P., 100 health, (3) - 2 A.M.P., 200 health, (4) - 3 A.M.P., 350 health, (5) - 4 A.M.P., 500 health.

Bastion.effect: Your team gains 10 Armor and Magic Resist. Bastions gain more. For the first 10 seconds of combat, Bastions increase their bonus by 100%. (2) - 18 armor and magic resist, (4) - 50 armor and magic resist, (6) - 90 armor and magic resist, Non-Bastions gain an additional 40 armor and magic resist.

Bruiser.effect: Your team gains 100 Health. Bruisers gain more. (2) - 20% health, (4) - 45% health, (6) - 75% health. Dynamo - Every 3 seconds, your team gains Mana. Dynamos gain 100% more. (2) - 5 manam, (3) - 7 mana, (4) - 10 mana.

Executioner.effect: Executioner Abilities can critically strike. They also gain bonus Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage. If the target's Health is below 30%, the bonus Critical Strike Damage is doubled. (2) - 25% critical strike chance, 8% critical strike damage, (3) - 35% critical strike chance, 15% critical strike damage, (4) - 45% critical strike chance, 20% critical strike damage, (5) - 55% critical strike chance, 25% critical strike damage; also gain 15% Durability.

Marksman.effect: Marksman gain Attack Damage. After 8 seconds of combat, they increase their bonus by 100%. (2) - 18% attack speed, (4) - 40% attack speed. After 8 seconds, gain 20% attack speed every 6 seconds.

Rapidfire.effect: Your team gains 10% Attack Speed. Rapidfire champions gain more on each attack, stacking up to 10 times. (2) - 4% attack speed per stack, (4) - 10% attack speed per stack, (6) - 22% attack speed per stack.

Slayer.effect: Slayers gain Attack Damage and Omnivamp. Overhealing heals the lowest percent Health Slayer for 50% of the excess amount. (2) - 15% attack damage, 15% omivamp, (4) - 40% attack damage, 15% omnivamp, (6) - 70% attack damage, 20% omnivamp.

Strategist.effect: Combat Start: Allies in the back 2 rows gain Damage Amp. Allies in the front 2 rows gain Durability. Strategists get triple. (2) - 7% damage amp, 5% durability, (3) - 11% damage amp, 7% durability, (4) - 16% damage amp, 11% durability, (5) - 20% damage amp, 13% durability.

Techie.effect: Techies gain Ability Power. Enemies hit by their abilities deal 10% less damage for 3 seconds. (2) - 15 ability power, (4) - 45 ability power, (6) - 80 ability power, (8) - 110 ability power and Enemies hit deal 18% less damage.

Vanguard.effect: Vanguards gain 10% Durability while Shielded. Combat start and 50% Health: Gain a max Health Shield for 10 seconds. (2) - 16% max Health, (4) - 32% max Health, (6) - 40% max Health; 20% durability while Shielded.
